$comment: Built-in plugins that must stay forkable: a copy of the directory installs, typechecks, tests, and builds outside this monorepo with published packages only. See docs/forkable-plugins.md. The bb/forkable-plugin-imports lint rule, run by each plugin's lint script, rejects imports of workspace packages and @/ imports that no registry item provides. `pnpm check:plugin-forks` (scripts/check-plugin-forks.mjs) builds that copy in a temporary directory and runs its install, typecheck, tests, and bb plugin build.
